name: MongoDB Atlas  - Slow Queries
description: The MongoDB Atlas - Slow Queries dashboard provides details on the number of slow queries by type and their trends, connection IDs for slow queries, and slow server status.
title: MongoDB Atlas  - Slow Queries

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs "Slow query"
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx","attr.command.$db","attr.durationMillis" as severity,timestamp,component,context,database,duration
| number(duration)
| where duration > "{{duration}}"
| count by database
| order by _count desc
| limit 10

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs "Slow query"
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx","attr.command.$db","attr.durationMillis" as severity,timestamp,component,context,database,duration
| number(duration)
| where duration > "{{duration}}"
| count

panels.title: Slow CRUD Operations by Database and Collection

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs 
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx","attr.command.$db","attr.durationMillis","attr.command","attr.ns" as severity,timestamp,component,context,database,duration,db_cmd,collection
| where component matches "*COMMAND*"
| parse regex field=db_cmd "(?<crud_operation>^[^:]*)"
| parse regex field=crud_operation "(?<crud_operation>(?<=\").*(?=\"))"
| where (crud_operation matches "*find*" or crud_operation matches "*insert*" or crud_operation matches "*remove*" or crud_operation matches "*delete*" or crud_operation matches "*update*" or crud_operation matches "*get*" or crud_operation matches "*aggregate*" or crud_operation matches "*replace*" or crud_operation matches "*save*" or crud_operation matches "*bulkWrite*")
| min(duration), max(duration), avg(duration), pct(duration, 95), pct(duration, 75) by database,collection,crud_operation
| where _duration_pct_75 > _avg
| format("min: %f\nmax: %f\navg: %f\n75perc: %f\n95perc: %f", _min, _max, _avg, _duration_pct_75, _duration_pct_95) as stats
| fields -_min,_max,_avg, _duration_pct_95, _duration_pct_75

_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs

| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx","attr.command.$db","attr.durationMillis","attr.command","attr.ns" as severity,timestamp,component,context,database,duration,db_cmd,collection
| where component matches "*COMMAND*"
| parse regex field=db_cmd "(?<crud_operation>^[^:]*)"
| parse regex field=crud_operation "(?<crud_operation>(?<=\").*(?=\"))"
| where (crud_operation matches "*find*" or crud_operation matches "*insert*" or crud_operation matches "*remove*" or crud_operation matches "*delete*" or crud_operation matches "*update*" or crud_operation matches "*get*" or crud_operation matches "*aggregate*" or crud_operation matches "*replace*" or crud_operation matches "*save*" or crud_operation matches "*bulkWrite*")

panels.title: Queries with Scanned Objects/Returned Objects ratio greater than 1

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs 
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx","attr.command.$db","attr.durationMillis","attr.command","attr.ns","attr.nreturned","attr.docsExamined","attr.keysExamined" as severity,timestamp,component,context,database,duration,db_cmd,collection,nreturned,docs_examined,keys_examined 
| where component matches "*COMMAND*"
| parse regex field=db_cmd "(?<crud_operation>^[^:]*)"
| parse regex field=crud_operation "(?<crud_operation>(?<=\").*(?=\"))"
| where (crud_operation matches "*find*" or crud_operation matches "*insert*" or crud_operation matches "*remove*" or crud_operation matches "*delete*" or crud_operation matches "*update*" or crud_operation matches "*get*" or crud_operation matches "*aggregate*" or crud_operation matches "*replace*" or crud_operation matches "*save*" or crud_operation matches "*bulkWrite*")
| number(keys_examined) | number(docs_examined) | number(nreturned) | number(duration)
| where duration > "{{duration}}"
| count by database, collection, crud_operation, duration,keys_examined,docs_examined,nreturned
| docs_examined/nreturned as scanned_obj_by_return_ratio
| where scanned_obj_by_return_ratio > 1
| fields -_count
| sort by scanned_obj_by_return_ratio

panels.title: Indexed Keys by database and collection

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/MongoDBAtlas/logs INDEX
| json "msg","hostname","project_id","cluster_name" 
| json "s","t.$date","c","ctx","attr.namespace" as severity,timestamp,component,context,namespace
| where component matches "*INDEX*"
| parse regex field=namespace "(?<database>.+?(?=\.))"
| parse regex field=namespace "(?<collection>(?<=\.).+?(?=$))"
| count by project_id, cluster_name, hostname, database, collection
| sort by _count
